{{Quote|My planet Lannik is very primitive by galactic standards -- Its riches unmined, its forests uncut. Many are waiting to exploit its bounty!|Native of Lannik, [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]]|<ref name="SWR16">''[[Star Wars (1998) 16]]''</ref>}}
'''Lannik''' was a harsh and isolated world in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], inhabited by stocky humanoids known as [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lanniks]]. Their warlike homeworld integrated into the interstellar civilization relatively late, which caused it to suffer from chronic technological backwardness. The limited share of developments that did reach Lannik either provoked the rise of criminal groups or offered the local noble houses and clans a new way to advance their personal interests. The uncontrolled circulation of technology and the Lanniks’ unwillingness to negotiate condemned an already turbulent world to yet another cycle of wars, unrest, and uncertainty. This perpetual state of struggle, lasting for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]], gave rise to a culture of fierce but honorable warriors among the Lanniks.

==Description==
[[File:Lannik_LBE.png|thumb|left|150px|A Lannik]]
Lannik was ruled by a hereditary monarchy and was independent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Unlike most other Republic planets, the considerable natural resources and mineral wealth of Lannik were largely unmined and unexploited, making it a tempting prize for enterprising would-be manipulators such as Red Iaro leader [[General/Legends|General]] [[Myk'chur Finux Zug|Zug]] and corrupt [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] such as [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]].

[[Pugil]] was a sport popular on Lannik. A local team was the [[New Osler Flejj Beasts]].

==History==
The planet was discovered by [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]].

Lannik was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime between [[17,000 BBY]] and [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]. In [[11,198 BBY]], the planet was victim of the [[Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade]].<ref name="EW" />

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] came from [[Daalang/Legends|Daalang]] and [[Battle of the Lannik system (Great Sith War)|conquered]] the planet, from which they moved to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Lannik was the site of a [[Battle of the Lannik system (Jedi Civil War)|battle]] won by the Republic during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="EA" />

It suffered from anti-Republic terrorists known as the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] until [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and even at the end of the [[Swarm War]], the planet remained isolated.

The planet joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometime between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. It was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|Zsinj]] and [[Thrawn campaign]]s.<ref name="EA" />

Lannik was [[Battle of the Lannik system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EA" />
